description: This file defines a custom exception class 'FileNotReadableException' used within the ZipStream library to handle cases where a file isn't readable.

classes.name: FileNotReadableException
classes.description: A custom exception class that extends the base 'Exception' class to specifically handle cases where a file cannot be read.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the exception with a message indicating the specific file path that isn't readable.
